Thanks — quick legal POV while I draft redlines.

1) Change order approach: we should issue a formal Change Order to the existing Order Form (NH-OF-004) that references the Master Services Agreement (MSA) section that governs amendments (MSA §7). We should avoid changing core indemnity or data residency terms in the change order; keep scope and pricing limited.

2) SLA exception: we can permit a temporary operational SLA exception limited in time (Sept 13-20) and purpose (pilot/load validation). Suggested language: explicit start/end date, scope limited to the affected purchase order, and a carve-out stating it does not amend the main SLA in a permanent manner. Add an approval box requiring sign-off by VP of Ops (internal) and Nimbus procurement.

3) Billing/proration: standard proration for the month in which capacity is added. If they need hourly-level proration for the Sept 13 start, we can include a clause: "Customer billed pro rata for days active in month at the agreed rate." No unusual waivers.

4) Change order redlines: I'll attach a PDF with inline redlines (draft_change_order_redline.pdf). Key redline items: limits on liability unaffected, confidentiality standard retained, explicit rollback option if pilot causes production regressions.

Patricia (Nimbus legal) — adding you here so you and I can coordinate redline exchange directly if preferred.

I'll circulate a redline by EOD Mon (17th) for an internal look before we send to Nimbus.

-Rishi

On pricing/proration: I ran the numbers against their current committed rate. Two options so we can present to procurement quickly:

Option A — Short-term burst (Sept+Oct)
- Additional reserved capacity: +800k tokens/mo (to reach 1M)
- Rate: $0.0028 per token (list) 
- Monthly delta (pre-discount): $2,240
- With 10% courtesy discount: $2,016 per month
- Proration: bill pro rata based on calendar days active; for a Sept 13 start that equals 18/30 of the month on the first invoice.

Option B — Commit + discount (if they convert to a 3-month committed uplift)
- 3-month commit: rate $0.0024 per token
- Monthly delta: $1,920

Notes: include a fee line for the SLA exception as a one-time operational uplift of $1,500 to compensate for capacity reservation and SRE on-call during the validation week. Alternatively, we can absorb SRE monitoring at no charge as a commercial concession.

I'll prepare a simple change order PDF with the numbers and Claire from Billing can sign off on proration text. Marcus — if you expect additional operational costs, flag them now.

-Laura
